feed.title: Costco faces federal lawsuit accusing retailer of selling products linked to child and forced labor
feed.summary: Costco is facing a federal class-action lawsuit in Oregon, alleging the retailer sells products sourced from child and forced labor. The lawsuit claims chocolate, cashews, and shrimp sold by Costco are linked to exploitation in West Africa, Brazil, Vietnam, Guinea-Bissau, and India. The suit seeks $200 for each eligible Oregon Costco member and an injunction to halt the company's "unlawful" business practices, highlighting Costco's marketing as an "ethically sourced" retailer.

feed.title: John Deere Financial, AgVend Bring 0% & Low Rate Crop Input Financing into Retail Quote
feed.summary: John Deere Financial and AgVend have partnered to integrate 0% and low-rate crop input financing directly into retailers' AgVend platforms, making these offers visible during planning, quoting, and ordering. This initiative aims to provide growers with alternative lending options, allowing them to finance seed and crop protection purchases until November 2027, countering higher operating line interest rates. The integration also benefits retailers by taking on the financial risk and processing, functioning as an account receivable replacement tool.

feed.title: General Dynamics names Nedzbala interim IT president as Gilliland departs
feed.summary: General Dynamics has appointed Paul Nedzbala as interim president of its IT services business unit following the abrupt departure of Amy Gilliland. Gilliland had been GDIT's president since 2017, a tenure that included integrating CSRA after its 2018 acquisition and launching new technology strategies. Nedzbala, who joined GDIT via the CSRA acquisition, was previously the chief business officer.

feed.title: Starbucks loses bid to dismiss labor union's trademark case
feed.summary: A federal judge in Pennsylvania has denied Starbucks' request to dismiss a lawsuit filed by Workers United, the union representing thousands of its employees. The union's lawsuit aims to validate its use of the name "Starbucks Workers United" and a modified Starbucks logo, in response to the coffee giant's trademark infringement claims. This legal dispute is part of ongoing tensions between Starbucks and the union that began five years ago when the first employees unionized.

feed.title: Certified recycled plastic could reduce exposure to oil-price swings
feed.summary: SMX (Security Matters) PLC suggests that certified recycled plastic can be an economic alternative to virgin plastic, especially amidst global supply risks, oil price volatility, and geopolitical instability. The company's molecular marking technology helps verify the origin and content of recycled materials, transforming them into a valuable, verifiable asset that can compete with traditional oil-derived plastics on cost-efficiency rather than just environmental benefits. This approach aims to provide industrial resilience against material shortages and price shocks.

feed.title: Ford Sales Slide 6.6% After Model Phase-Outs

The company saw strong performance in its F-Series trucks, Maverick Hybrid, and Bronco sales, and maintained its adjusted EBIT guidance for 2026 despite a short-term supplier issue affecting F-150 production.

D-PLEX₁₀₀ is designed to prevent surgical site infections and successfully met its primary and key secondary endpoints in the Phase 3 SHIELD II trial.

feed.title: Sigma Lithium Temporarily Halts Operations in Brazil
feed.summary: Sigma Lithium has temporarily suspended mining and industrial operations in Brazil due to a delay by the Federal Court of Appeals in reviewing its legal defense against an environmental injunction. This pause is expected to delay the company's 12-month production guidance of 240,000 tons by three months, though its 2027 target remains unchanged. The injunction stemmed from a lawsuit alleging negative environmental impacts on a local community.

feed.title: UnitedHealth and Humana cutting Medicare Advantage plans in 2027
feed.summary: UnitedHealth and Humana are discontinuing Medicare Advantage plans covering over one million seniors, with CVS Health's Aetna and Centene also scaling back. This move is a response to rising medical costs and insufficient government reimbursement, leading to insurers pulling back from less profitable markets for the 2027 enrollment year. Affected members will need to select new plans, and UnitedHealth will restructure its offerings to focus on lower-cost options.

feed.title: Eversource reaches 500,000 smart meter milestone in Massachusetts
feed.summary: Eversource has installed its 500,000th smart meter in Massachusetts, marking a significant milestone in its statewide rollout aimed at providing customers with greater insight into their energy consumption and modernizing the electric grid. These smart meters enable customers to monitor their energy usage, receive high-bill alerts, and contribute to a more responsive electric system. The company expects to substantially complete the statewide rollout by the end of 2027, with high customer participation and an opt-out rate of less than 1%.

feed.title: Kroger Makes Major Change at All Its Stores and Customers Will Notice Immediately
feed.summary: Kroger is implementing a significant change across all its stores by requiring its nearly 400,000 employees to wear new company-issued uniforms. This marks the first time in over a decade that employees will not wear their own clothing, with specific attire for general staff and store leaders. Customers are expected to notice this change immediately as it rolls out across Kroger's 2,700+ stores, including its Fred Meyer and Harris Teeter brands.

feed.title: Tesla: Shares Rise on Third-Quarter Deliveries Ahead of Consensus Estimates
feed.summary: Tesla reported third-quarter deliveries of 486,532 vehicles, slightly down from 2025 but still ahead of consensus estimates, causing shares to rise 4%. Morningstar maintains its $450 fair value estimate, viewing Tesla shares as slightly undervalued, driven by the growth of its full self-driving (FSD) technology. The company anticipates around 10% deliveries growth in 2026, with upcoming earnings expected to provide updates on robotaxi plans, FSD version 15, and the Optimus humanoid robot.

feed.title: Regeneron Highlights Promising Ovarian Cancer, Muscle Preservation Trial Data
feed.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals shared promising Phase 1/2 clinical trial results for ubamatamab in recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer, showing a 73% objective response rate. Additionally, Phase 2 COURAGE trial data for trevogrumab combined with semaglutide demonstrated muscle preservation in weight loss, with lower doses retaining significant lean mass. The company plans further studies and regulatory discussions for these therapies.

feed.title: Chipotle to open Madison Heights location Monday
feed.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill is scheduled to open a new restaurant in Madison Heights, Virginia, on Monday. Located at 4780 S Amherst Highway, the establishment will feature a "Chipotlane" drive-thru for digital orders. The new Chipotle will operate daily from 10:45 a.m. to 10 p.m.
